This is "no" enforcement (nothing in code reads/blocks it) — though arguably the absence is itself the implementation. Per strict scale, "not running an optimizer" isn't an enforced mechanism — it's just prose. I'll rate those minimization claims about not-optimizing as "no" (no code path enforces it).
